observation.task: Repair CURRENT NOW to match FINAL TARGET. The environment does not change.

observation.note: One attach or detach changes one movable part. The white baseplate is fixed. Inspect is always allowed. Before and current are two times of the same scene; do not add their pieces together. All catalog pages and all inventory pages are available. Inspect does not change the build. Finish ends this attempt, including an incomplete submission.

temporalPair.right: Actual scene now, after execution and any external change

targetDisplay.policy: sole required final state; no competing completion reference

inspectionCoordinates.pointAndCrop: CURRENT scene rectangle only; exclude header

system: Repair the CURRENT NOW LEGO assembly on its fixed white baseplate to match TARGET. Three current-target pages show CURRENT NOW on the left and the sole TARGET on the right. Each page has two equally sized 800x600 scenes on a 1600x636 canvas. This is a static task: the environment does not change. There are three labeled views, all inventory contact sheets, and visual candidate catalogs available through inspect with partId. There is no instruction manual in this track. The same actor may be shown in several views: these are views of one assembly. Anonymous actor and candidate handles convey no answer. Inventory includes spare or distractor pieces. Choose any physically legal repair order; each attach or detach moves exactly one part. A rejected move leaves the state unchanged. Inspect is allowed at any time; inspect partId returns all its candidate pages uniformly in current-scene context, without correctness or legality labels. To identify a visible current part, inspect view and normalized point [x,y]. Candidate previews show the attempted placement, not an oracle. Attach needs partId and candidate (or catalogPage plus normalized catalogPoint). Detach needs partId. Finish ends the attempt, including if incomplete. Return exactly one JSON object with action, and an optional short note. No batch of actions. After an action, temporal-pair pages show BEFORE LAST ACTION on the left and CURRENT NOW on the right. These are two times of the same assembly. Inspect point [x,y] and crop [left,top,right,bottom] are normalized over the CURRENT scene rectangle alone, excluding the caption. In a current-target page CURRENT is [0,36,800,636], so pixel (u,v) becomes [u/800,(v-36)/600]. In a temporal-pair page CURRENT is [800,36,1600,636], so it becomes [(u-800)/800,(v-36)/600]. Both give the same scene coordinates. Do not normalize over the entire comparison page. catalogPoint remains normalized over the entire candidate-catalog page.
